task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an life changing round of TextWorld? You do! Here is your task for today. First stop, make sure that the chest drawer in the bedroom is open. And then, pick up the old key from the chest drawer in the bedroom. And then, unlock the wooden door with the old key. After that, open the wooden door within the bedroom. After that, go to the east. Okay, and then, open the screen door. After that, try to head east. And then, go south. Following that, recover the milk from the floor of the garden. After that, make an attempt to go to the north. After that, attempt to venture west. If you can accomplish that, place the milk on the stove within the kitchen. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You arrive in a bedroom. A normal kind of place.

You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a chest drawer! Look over there! an antique trunk. As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a king-size bed. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? But the thing is empty. Hm. Oh well

There is a closed wooden door leading east.

summary: I am in the bedroom with a closed wooden door leading east and a chest drawer revealed by a secret button.
thought: I should open the chest drawer in the bedroom first.
feedback:
You open the chest drawer, revealing an old key.
